title: Free boundary regularity in obstacle problems with a degenerate forcing term
summary: In this paper, we consider the properties of a special free boundary point in the following obstacle problem: The Laplacian of u equals f(x) multiplied by the characteristic function of the set where u is positive within the two-dimensional unit ball, where $f(x)=|x|$ is a degenerate forcing term. The key challenge stems from the degeneracy of $f(x)$, which leads to a more complex structure of the free boundary compared to the classical setting.
